source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeInvocableActionDescribeEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Invocable.Action action = Invocable.Action.createStandardAction('localNoop'); List<Invocable.Action.DescribeResult> results = action.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals(1, results.size()); Invocable.Action.DescribeResult describe = results[0]; System.assertEquals(action, describe.getAction()); System.assertEquals(false, describe.getAllowsTransactionControl()); System.assertEquals(0, describe.getCapabilityTypes().size()); System.assertEquals('', describe.getCategory()); System.assertEquals('', describe.getConfigurationEditor()); System.assertEquals('', describe.getDescription()); System.assertEquals(0, describe.getGenericTypes().size()); System.assertEquals(false, describe.getHasCallout()); System.assertEquals(false, describe.getHasSystemGeneratedOutput()); System.assertEquals('', describe.getIconId()); System.assertEquals('', describe.getIconName()); System.assertEquals(0, describe.getInputs().size()); System.assertEquals('localNoop', describe.getLabel()); System.assertEquals('', describe.getMethodDescription()); System.assertEquals('localNoop', describe.getMethodLabel()); System.assertEquals('localNoop', describe.getMethodName()); System.assertEquals('localNoop', describe.getName()); System.assertEquals(0, describe.getOutputs().size()); System.assertEquals('', describe.getTargetEntityName()); System.assertEquals('localNoop', describe.getType()); } }
